description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. (20/2009)
reasoning: This gazette notice involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing Certificates of Exemption under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). The content specifically deals with regulatory matters - exempting certain entities from licensing requirements for electricity distribution. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the application and enforcement of existing legislation and regulatory frameworks.
